и опционально задавать причину для каждой. Поля, не переданные в теле,

AdminRoleEnum.title: AdminRoleEnum
AdminRoleEnum.description:
SQLAlchemy/Pydantic-facing counterpart of `AdminRole`.

Lives here (not `backend/app/models/enums.py`, which re-exports it for backward
compatibility) so `modules/admins/infrastructure/models.py` never needs to import from the
`app.models` package — that package's own `__init__.py` re-exports `Admin` *from* this
module, and a dependency back the other way (this module needing something from
`app.models`) would be a circular import.

AttemptSubmitterOut.title: AttemptSubmitterOut
AttemptSubmitterOut.description:
Trimmed user summary for the admin results view's clickable profile link (Task 077) --
deliberately not the full `forms`' `SubmitterOut` PII set (no birth date/phone/email/study
group): this module only needs enough to render a name + avatar that opens `UserCardPanel`,
which re-fetches the full card itself. Duplicated here rather than imported from
`modules.forms` -- one business module's presentation schema is not another's dependency.

CampaignSourceOut.title: CampaignSourceOut
CampaignSourceOut.description:
First-touch campaign-link attribution (Task 026) — read-only, set once at membership
creation, never on later opens.

ChatSettings.title: ChatSettings
ChatSettings.description:

выключается для ботов без поддержки/базы знаний (например, чисто
информационных), которым текстовые сообщения не нужны.

ConsentBotIdentityIn.title: ConsentBotIdentityIn
ConsentBotIdentityIn.description:
Body for the bot-channel consent endpoints -- MAX identity only, bot-runtime
authenticated the same way /messages/ingress is. Does not create a `User` row (see
ConsentGate on messages_router.py / auth_router.py for where that happens).

PolicyDocumentContentOut.title: PolicyDocumentContentOut
PolicyDocumentContentOut.description:
Public read of the raw HTML (no page shell), for the mini-app's in-app policy screen.
`None` when unset, mirrors ConsentNoticeOut.

PolicyDocumentHtmlIn.title: PolicyDocumentHtmlIn
PolicyDocumentHtmlIn.description:
The full policy document, as admin-authored HTML rendered on our own page
(GET /consent/policy-document) -- same request/response shape both ways, mirrors
ConsentNoticeIn.

ProfileSettings.title: ProfileSettings
ProfileSettings.description:
Per-bot visibility of the mini-app's «Профиль» tab (Task 054) — off only for bots an
admin explicitly turns it off for; default stays on, preserving today's behavior for
every existing bot. Enforced bidirectionally against profile_schema/installed
capabilities at write time (see UpdateBotInstance/CreateBotInstance), not by blocking
GET/PUT /profile at request time — see docs/tasks/054-configurable-profile-tab.md's
"Rejected design" note for why the latter would break session auth.
